result.rationale: The migration line `execute("SELECT c.id FROM categories ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i` unconditionally indexes [0] and calls ['id']. If the embed_category site setting was never explicitly persisted (default '' per the removed site_settings.yml entry), the query returns zero rows; PG::Result#[] at index 0 returns nil and ['id'] raises NoMethodError, aborting the migration on sites that never configured embedding. The diff shows no guard around this lookup (unlike the embeddable_hosts query which checks cmd_tuples). This is a verifiable defect introduced by the diff.
